description: Completely rewrite the public registration form (index.php) to include all new fields organized into a 5-step wizard with comprehensive sections. Includes WhatsApp field, no NID field.
steps: Redesign the step wizard from 3 steps to 5 steps: Step 1 - Head Teacher/Principal Info (প্রধান শিক্ষকের তথ্য), Step 2 - Institution Basic Info (প্রতিষ্ঠানের মৌলিক তথ্য), Step 3 - Address & Location (ঠিকানা ও অবস্থান), Step 4 - Infrastructure & Students (অবকাঠামো ও শিক্ষার্থী), Step 5 - Technology & Vision (প্রযুক্তি ও লক্ষ্য)

Step 1 fields: head_teacher_name (required), head_teacher_phone (required, BD mobile), head_teacher_whatsapp (optional, BD mobile or international - label it 'WhatsApp Number'), head_teacher_email (required, email), managing_committee_chairman (optional), managing_committee_phone (optional). NOTE: No NID field at all.

Step 2 fields: institution_type (required, select from expanded list via institution_types()), school_name (required), school_name_bn (optional), eiin_number (optional, numeric), mpo_status (required, select: mpo/non_mpo/newly_nationalized), establishment_year (optional, 4-digit year), school_phone (optional), school_email (optional), school_website (optional)

Step 3 fields: division (required, select from 8 divisions - pre-fill 'চট্টগ্রাম'), district (required, select - pre-fill 'কক্সবাজার'), upazila (required, select - pre-fill 'মহেশখালী'), union_ward (required, select from Maheshkhali unions - replaces old union_name), village (optional), postal_code (optional), detailed_address (required), latitude (auto/optional), longitude (auto/optional) with GPS button

Step 4 fields: total_students (required), total_students_boys (optional), total_students_girls (optional), per-class student counts students_class_1 through students_class_10 (all optional, in a compact grid), total_teachers (required), male_teachers (optional), female_teachers (optional), trained_teachers (optional), untrained_teachers (optional), num_buildings (optional), num_classrooms (optional), has_computer_lab (yes/no radio), has_science_lab (yes/no radio), has_library (yes/no radio), has_playground (yes/no radio)

Step 5 fields: num_computers (optional), has_internet (yes/no radio), internet_type (select: broadband/mobile_data/fiber/none - shown conditionally if has_internet=yes), num_projectors (optional), has_multimedia_classroom (yes/no radio), existing_software (textarea, optional), ict_teacher_available (yes/no radio, required), subdomain (required, with live preview), smart_school_reason (required textarea), notes (optional textarea), terms_accept checkbox
Update the stepper nav indicators to show 5 steps with appropriate icons and labels
Update the JavaScript wizard navigation to handle 5 steps, update validateStep() to cover the new fields, update the error-jump logic for 5 steps

Keep all existing styling patterns (CSS custom properties, bd-* class names, section banners with color variants, grid layout). Add additional CSS only for new elements like class-grid for per-class student inputs

The old owner_name/owner_phone/owner_email fields should map to head_teacher_name/head_teacher_phone/head_teacher_email in the form (the submit name attributes). Keep backward compatibility by mapping: owner_name = head_teacher_name, owner_phone = head_teacher_phone, owner_email = head_teacher_email in the form field names so submit.php can handle both old and new field names. Actually, keep the form field names as owner_name, owner_phone, owner_email for the head teacher to maintain backward compat with submit.php - just relabel them as Head Teacher info.

Ensure the union_name field is now renamed to union_ward in the form (the select element name attribute) BUT also submit a hidden field union_name that copies the union_ward value for backward compat with the DB schema. Actually simpler: keep the form field name as union_name since that column still exists in DB, the new union_ward column is additional context.
acceptance_criteria: php -l index.php passes without syntax errors
The form renders 5 distinct step panels with proper navigation
All new fields use the $o() helper for old-input repopulation
The stepper indicators update correctly for 5 steps
The form still submits to submit.php with method POST and includes CSRF token and honeypot
Bilingual labels are present on all fields (Bangla primary, English)
WhatsApp number field is present in Step 1
No NID field exists anywhere in the form
findings: Complete 5-step wizard implemented. All PHP syntax checks pass. WhatsApp field (head_teacher_whatsapp) included in Step 1. No NID field anywhere. Backward compat maintained: owner_name, owner_phone, owner_email field names kept for head teacher. union_name kept as select name with hidden union_ward synced via JS. institution_types() helper used for dynamic type options. Class-wise student grid uses 5-column layout. All radio groups use bd-pills pattern. Error-jump logic updated for 5 steps.
